resolution: Generation 1 provides a deterministic held-out transfer/recovery benchmark on accepted F2-WP-800. Tested policies consume only public ObservationView values plus explicit immutable public policy/checkpoint state. Source/target public fixture identity, holdout identity, episode/run/generation identity and checkpoint provenance are bound; evaluator-private nodes/transitions/scores remain outside policy input. Checkpoint-resume, cold-restart and public-only planning baselines are compared at matched budgets. Exact PR-head and merged-main repository-hosted CI both passed compile and the transfer/recovery falsification suite. Trigger-6 post-merge fusion found no blocker at this scope, while preserving two promotion boundaries: evaluator efficiency counters are not runtime-efficiency evidence until trace-derived or trace-bound, and current transfer evidence is cross-fixture/cross-holdout only rather than structural OOD unless explicit transfer-family/split identity is bound. No runtime, VPS, physical GRID10, GWT/J-Space, provider/model, training, goal-authority, effect, completion or whole-system credit is granted.
